entities.summary: Hichem Djait, a prominent historian and scholar of Islam, was born on December 6, 1935, in Tunis, Tunisia. He is best known for his work on the history of Islamic civilization and its interactions with Western cultures. Djait's scholarship spanned over four decades, during which he taught at several universities and published numerous books and articles. He was a key figure in the development of modern Islamic studies and played a significant role in shaping the field's approach to its subject matter. Djait's work had a lasting impact on the understanding of Islamic history and its relevance to contemporary global issues. He died on June 1, 2021, leaving behind a legacy of scholarship and intellectual contributions that continue to inspire new generations of historians and scholars.
